These shared low values suggest a common benign-like profile. The model incorrectly assigns malignancy (291) or benignity (205) despite these shared features. The inconsistency in concavity, concave points, and symmetry indicates subtle malignant traits in a benign-typical setting, suggesting that the model is sensitive to minor deviations that are not strongly correlated with class. The shared low values across several key morphological features (especially smoothness, compactness, fractal dimension) may create a spurious correlation that leads to misclassification—particularly when the model relies on features with high inter-class variation or poor discriminative power.
